drafts_today.text: Wait between skincare steps? For skin 40+, give each layer 30 seconds. Cleanse, then pat serum on damp skin, then press in cream. Slow is how it actually sinks in, especially in dry November air. #SkinBarrier #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 15 seconds: phone timer on the counter counting 30s between each step. Cleanse, pat RIMAN serum on damp skin, press in cream. End card: '90 seconds. That's the whole routine.'

drafts_today.text: First week of November and your skin feels tight by noon? It's not your age, it's the air. Swap a foaming cleanser for a gentle one, hydrate on damp skin, and seal it in with a richer cream at night. #WinterSkin #DrySkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds: breath fogging a cold window, cut to swapping a foaming cleanser for a cream cleanser, then pressing cream into cheeks. Caption: 'Tight by noon? Fix the night before.'

drafts_today.text: You don't need 10 products to look rested after 40. You need three you use every day. My November reset: gentle cleanse, one good serum, one rich cream. That's it. Want my picks? DM me. #FewerProducts #SkincareOver40
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: a crowded bathroom shelf gets swept down to three RIMAN products lined up. Hands use each one in order. End card: 'Three. Every day. Done.'
